ZERO WASTE BOOTH · INTERACTIVE GAME

SHARE
THE CARE!

The party is over. Clean the kitchen, prepare the waste, and sort each item into the right place.

Nine items. One animated kitchen. 60 seconds.

HOW TO PLAY

Pick up. Prepare. Sort.

The waste items are PNG images. The kitchen, sink, water and interaction effects are CSS/JavaScript.

1. PICK UP

Drag any item from the kitchen. The items are placed naturally on the table, counter and floor.

2. WASH

Move dirty plastics over the sink. The water turns on while the item is over the sink and stops when you move away.

3. PREPARE & SORT

Flatten cardboard on the table, then drag each item to the correct bin or battery drop-off.

4. FINISH

Correct items disappear into their destination. Finish all nine before the 60-second timer ends.

Tip: hover over an item to see its name. When you drag an item across the sink, the faucet reacts immediately.
